items.title: Bronstein, Gewirtz & Grossman LLC Urges AST SpaceMobile, Inc. Investors to Act: Class Action Filed Alleging Investor Harm
items.summary: A class action lawsuit has been filed against AST SpaceMobile, Inc. alleging securities fraud. The complaint claims the company made false statements regarding its capital requirements, competitive position in the satellite direct-to-cell market, and user adoption rates. The class period covers March 4, 2025 to July 15, 2026, with a lead plaintiff deadline of November 13, 2026.

items.title: ROSEN, TRUSTED INVESTOR COUNSEL, Encourages AST SpaceMobile, Inc. Investors to Secure Counsel Before Important Deadline in Securities Class Action - ASTS
items.summary: Rosen Law Firm has filed a class action lawsuit against AST SpaceMobile, Inc. on behalf of investors who purchased securities between March 4, 2025 and July 15, 2026. The lawsuit alleges that defendants made false and misleading statements regarding the company's capital requirements, liquidity position, competitive standing in the satellite D2C market, and user adoption rates in the U.S. and Japan. The deadline to serve as lead plaintiff is November 13, 2026.

items.title: ROSEN, TOP RANKED GLOBAL COUNSEL, Encourages AST SpaceMobile, Inc. Investors with Losses in Excess of $100K to Secure Counsel Before Important Deadline in Securities Class Action - ASTS
items.summary: Rosen Law Firm has filed class action lawsuits against AST SpaceMobile, Inc. and other companies on behalf of investors who suffered losses. The lawsuit alleges that AST SpaceMobile made false statements regarding its capital requirements, competitive position, and user adoption rates, leading to investor damages when the true details emerged.

items.title: SHAREHOLDER ALERT Bernstein Liebhard LLP Announces A Securities Fraud Class Action Lawsuit Has Been Filed Against AST SpaceMobile, Inc. (ASTS)
items.summary: Bernstein Liebhard LLP has announced securities fraud class action lawsuits against three companies: AST SpaceMobile (ASTS) for investors who purchased shares between March 4, 2025 and July 15, 2026; Baidu (BIDU) for shareholders between November 18, 2025 and August 17, 2026; and Lincoln Educational Services (LINC) for shareholders between May 11, 2026 and August 9, 2026. The lawsuits allege materially false and misleading statements regarding business operations, growth prospects, and financial stability, resulting in artificially inflated stock prices and investor losses.

items.title: INVESTOR ALERT: Pomerantz Law Firm Reminds Investors with Losses on their Investment in Babcock & Wilcox Enterprises, Inc. of Class Action Lawsuit - BW
items.summary: Pomerantz Law Firm has filed class action lawsuits against Babcock & Wilcox Enterprises, Inc. (BW) on behalf of investors who acquired securities between November 5, 2025, and March 11, 2026. The firm is also investigating claims on behalf of investors in Abeona Therapeutics Inc. (ABEO) and has announced a class action lawsuit against AST SpaceMobile, Inc. (ASTS) and certain officers.

items.title: AST SPACEMOBILE, INC. (ASTS) INVESTOR ALERT Investors With Large Losses in AST SpaceMobile, Inc. Should Contact Bernstein Liebhard LLP To Discuss Their Rights
items.summary: A securities class action lawsuit has been filed against AST SpaceMobile, Inc. on behalf of investors who purchased securities between March 4, 2025 and July 15, 2026. The lawsuit alleges that defendants made materially false and misleading statements regarding the company's business operations, growth prospects, and financial stability, causing AST securities to trade at artificially inflated prices. Investors who suffered losses are encouraged to contact Bernstein Liebhard LLP, with a lead plaintiff deadline of November 13, 2026.
